title: Mean of the normalized sign sum
statement: For every natural number $n$, the uniform average over $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$ of the normalized coordinate sum $n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ is zero, with the coefficient interpreted as zero when $n=0$.
